questions.question:
A question is given, followed by two statements numbered (I) and (II). You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements is sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and select the appropriate answer.

**Question: **How many people are standing in the row if A, R, M and B are among the people standing in it where all people are facing north?

**Statements:**

(I) A is fourth from the left end; M is second to the right of A; and R is second from the left end.

(II) M is fourth from the right end; only two people Stand between M and B. B is to the right of M.

options.text: Data in either statement I alone or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question
Data in statements I and II together is sufficient to answer the question
Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not
Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not

questions.solution:
Given : A certain number of people are standing in the row facing in the north direction.

Explanation : 

 
• Statement (I) → M is fourth from the right end; only two people Stand between M and B. B is to the right of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73bb46b1dd4cc5bba4592d0e5a08685b96e28392f48dcb0fb4e20c5a48c11314.png] ​

​As it cannot be determined whether M is standing at the right end or there are any other people standing to the right of M, therefore total number of people are standing in the row where all people are facing north cannot be answered. 

So, statement (I) is not sufficient to answer the question.

 
• Statement (II) → M is fourth from the right end; only two people Stand between M and B.
 
• 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6308c5a7253673ac9fc5b8bbbd949817706583770c548dde607485e1549ed116.png] 

​As any specific position of B cannot be determined with respect to M, so there are two possible positions of B i.e B1 and B2 shown above.

So, statement (II) is not sufficient to answer the question.

Now, Using both the statements :

 
• Statement (I) + Statement (II) → A is fourth from the left end; M is second to the right of A; and R is second from the left end. M is fourth from the right end; only two people Stand between M and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bb656d401a48310562a620612e6aa11f5320c4fa0d2a810366a2c8ac8708e0f.png] ​

**So, using both statements there are a total of 9 people are standing in the row where all people are facing north. Thus data in statements I and II together is sufficient to answer the question.**

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.

In this question, a question is followed by two statements numbered (I) and (II). You have to decide whether the data provided in the statement/s are sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and choose your answer carefully.

**Question:** P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are 7 people standing in a row all facing North (not necessarily in the same order). Who is standing second to the right of T?

**Statements:**

(I) U is standing 3rd from the right end and 2nd to the left of R.

(II) Q is standing to the immediate right of T. Q is standing 2nd to the left of P

options.text: The data in both the Statements (I) and (II) together are sufficient to answer the question.
The data in Statement (II) alone is sufficient to answer the question, while the data in statement (I) alone is not sufficient to answer the question.
The data in Statement (I) alone is sufficient to answer the question, while the data in Statement (II) alone is not sufficient to answer the question.
The data in both the Statements (I) and (II) together are NOT sufficient to answer the question.

questions.solution:
Given : 

 
• Six people - P, Q, R, S, T, U and V
 
• All of them are standing in a row all facing north.

Explanation :

 
• Statement - (I) : U is standing 3rd from the right end and 2nd to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2f5e125dfd24dc984d31585caa4072d9c5b5dbe78e0648810a9760db4c1f731.png] 

**Here, Only position of U and R is given, therefore positions of the left five people cannot be determined and who is standing second to the right of T cannot be answered.**

**Thus, data in statement (I) alone is not sufficient to answer the question.**

 
• Statement - (II) : Q is standing to the immediate right of T. Q is standing 2nd to the left of P

Here, position of P cannot be determined, therefore position of Q and T cannot be determined. Also position of the left four people cannot be determined therefore who is standing second to the right of T cannot be answered.

Thus, data in statement (II) alone is not sufficient to answer the question.

 
• Combining both the statements - U is standing 3rd from the right end and 2nd to the left of R. Q is standing to the immediate right of T. Q is standing 2nd to the left of P.

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2f5e125dfd24dc984d31585caa4072d9c5b5dbe78e0648810a9760db4c1f731.png] 

​Here, position of P cannot be determined, therefore position of Q and T cannot be determined. Also position of the left out four people cannot be determined therefore who is standing second to the right of T cannot be answered.

**Therefore, The data in both the Statements (I) and (II) together are NOT sufficient to answer the question.**

Hence, "Option - (4)" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
A situation is given, followed by two conclusions I and II. Read the situation and both the conclusions carefully and select the correct answer.

**Situation:**

Since the past 15 years, 75% of the products in the world’s pottery market comes from Country K. However, the employment in the pottery industry of Country K has been consistently declining by 5-9% every year since the past 3 years.

**Conclusions:**

I. Even after declining employment, Country K has enough potters to continue contributing equally to the international market.

II. The local demand of pottery in Country K has substantially decreased leading to less interest among potters.

options.text: Neither I nor II can be concluded
Both I and II can be concluded

questions.solution:
**Explanation:**

**I. Even after declining employment, Country K has enough potters to continue contributing equally to the international market.:** From the situation given, it can be inferred that despite the declining employment in the pottery industry in Country K, the country continues to contribute significantly (75%) to the world's pottery market. This implies that even after the decline in employment, Country K has enough potters to continue contributing equally to the international market. **Therefore, the conclusion I can be concluded.**

**II. The local demand of pottery in Country K has substantially decreased leading to less interest among potters:** On the other hand, there is no information provided in the situation about the local demand of pottery in Country K. We cannot assume or infer that the decline in employment is due to a decreased local demand for pottery, as the reduction in employment could be due to other factors, such as increased automation, outsourcing, or a change in manufacturing techniques. **Therefore, conclusion II cannot be concluded.**

Hence, the correct option here is "**3) Only I can be concluded**".

questions.question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

The position of the English alphabet is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First letter → (2) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter → (2) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,
